name: dropdown-menu-15
description: Insert block menu for a document editor with icon tiles and helper descriptions.

files.content: import { CodeIcon, Heading1Icon, ListChecksIcon, ListIcon, MegaphoneIcon, PlusIcon, TableIcon, } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuGroup, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/dropdown-menu" const blocks = [ { label: "Heading", hint: "Big section title", icon: Heading1Icon }, { label: "Bulleted list", hint: "Simple unordered list", icon: ListIcon }, { label: "To-do list", hint: "Track tasks with checkboxes", icon: ListChecksIcon, }, { label: "Code block", hint: "Syntax highlighted snippet", icon: CodeIcon }, { label: "Table", hint: "Rows and columns of data", icon: TableIcon }, { label: "Callout", hint: "Make text stand out", icon: MegaphoneIcon }, ] export default function EditorInsertBlockMenu() { return ( }> Insert Basic blocks {blocks.map((block) => ( {block.label} {block.hint} ))} ) }
